why: Fixed viewpoints the benchmark pins the headset's camera to (bench.py), and the offline harness renders (offline_frame::render_the_bench_views), so the frame measured on the device can be looked at on the development machine. World metres; eye height 1.6 m. Names are letters, digits, '_' and '-'.

views.name: hall_back
views.note: Back of the marble hall toward the front wall: the whole hall, the pillar, the most reflective floor on screen.

views.name: hall_front
views.note: From the front door down the hall at the pillar's base.

views.name: pillar
views.note: Close on the pillar and its floor reflection.

views.name: toward_door
views.note: Facing the front door: the floor reflects the terrain and the sky through it.

views.name: hallway
views.note: Down the stone hallway past the wall sconces.

views.name: corner_pool
views.note: The back corner spot's pool on the right wall.

views.name: outdoors_front
views.note: Outside, facing the building's front across the ground: terrain, facade and sky.

views.name: outdoors_field
views.note: Outside, looking away from the building over the terrain: the ground shader across most of the screen.

views.name: outdoors_walls
views.note: Outside at the front-left corner (headset 2026-09-29 00:12:49): two polished walls reflecting the ground and the hills, every pixel a ground trace.

views.name: brick_hall
views.note: Inside the brick hall from its front door toward the back: brick walls, the ceiling lamp's pool, the wall wash behind.

views.name: brick_hall_diagonal
views.note: The brick hall from its back corner across to both doorways (the one reported as the slowest room, 2026-09-29).

views.name: sconce_jamb
views.note: The polished doorway jamb beside the hallway's south sconce: its reflection of the wall behind the sconce (stepped outline until the prop-free photographs, 2026-09-29).

views.name: sconce_below
views.note: Looking up at the hallway's south sconce from near the floor: its underside as drawn, beside how its cards show it in reflections (2026-09-29).

views.name: hall_to_hallway_floor
views.note: From the hall toward the hallway door: the south sconce as drawn and its reflection in the marble floor, in one frame (headset 22:07:41, 2026-09-29).

views.name: player_shadow
views.note: Looking down behind your own body, away from the hall's front pendant: your crisp shadow from the lamp lighting you most falls here (the characters' shadow tiles, 2026-09-29).

views.name: floor_mirror_self
views.note: Looking down at the marble by your own feet: your body in the floor's reflection, mirrored rather than as capsules (the characters' floor mirror, 2026-09-30).

views.name: floor_mirror_lit
views.note: Standing in the front pendant's pool of light, looking down at your feet: your lit body mirrored in the marble (the characters' floor mirror, 2026-09-30).
